eras.name: Golden Age
eras.description: The dawn of Timely Comics. Marvel ancestor publisher launched with Marvel Comics #1, introducing the original Human Torch and Namor the Sub-Mariner. Wartime patriotism drove the debut of Captain America.

eras.name: Atlas Era
eras.description: Timely rebranded as Atlas Comics. Superhero sales collapsed; pivoted to monster, horror, western, war, and romance.

eras.name: Silver Age
eras.description: The Marvel Universe was born. Fantastic Four #1 launched a shared continuity of flawed, human heroes.

eras.name: Bronze Age
eras.description: Marvel matured, tackling social issues and introducing street-level, complex characters.

eras.name: Modern Age
eras.description: Line-wide crossovers and the 90s art boom defined the era.

eras.name: Dark Age
eras.description: Marvel faced bankruptcy, leading to bold experiments like Heroes Reborn and the Onslaught event.

eras.name: Marvel Knights & Ultimate Era
eras.description: Imprints redefined quality and accessibility, paving the road to the MCU.

eras.name: Event Era
eras.description: Annual, line-wide events defined the status quo.

eras.name: MCU Synergy Era
eras.description: Comics aligned with films through massive relaunches and new hero iterations.

eras.name: Krakoan Age & Beyond
eras.description: A holistic relaunch of the X-Men franchise.
